## Cost assumptions

Where a choice existed, the assumption that makes the result look WORSE was taken.

- Taker fee 0.050% on BOTH sides of every trade (OKX Lv1 (regular user), recorded 2026-08-09 from https://www.okx.com/help/trading-fee-rules-faq). Plumb uses market orders, so the maker rate never applies.
- Slippage = 1bp floor + 2bp per 400 USDT of notional + 0.05 × the bar's own range. Larger orders and more violent bars fill worse.
- Entries fill at the NEXT bar's open, never the close the signal was computed on.
- Stops fill at the WORSE of the stop price and the next bar's open, then slip further against us. Gaps always go against us.
- Funding is booked every 8h from the REAL historical series, sign preserved. Where no history is stored (OKX retains ~97 days), a pessimistic 0.0100% is charged as a COST regardless of direction, and the count of such settlements is reported.

## What this does not prove

- **It is not a prediction.** It is a measurement of how this configuration would have behaved
  over one particular stretch of history, which will not repeat.
- **The sample is 158 out-of-sample trades over 940 days.** Even a clean result on
  this many trades carries wide error bars; the Monte Carlo above is the honest picture of that.
- **One market regime.** The stored history covers a specific period. A strategy that survives it
  has not been tested against the regimes that period did not contain.
- **Fills are modelled, not observed.** Slippage, spread and gap behaviour are assumptions, chosen
  pessimistically but still assumptions. Real fills will differ.
- **No exchange outage, API failure, or partial fill is simulated.** The live system will meet all
  three, and P5's reconciliation exists because of it.
- **Funding before the stored window uses a fallback rate.** OKX retains ~97 days of funding
  history; 11151 settlements in this run used the pessimistic fallback.
- **Passing this gate is a licence to risk 400 USDT, nothing more.** It is not evidence of edge at
  any other size, on any other instrument, or in any other market condition.

## Run notes

- Configuration: breakout_range. Strategies enabled: breakout_range.
- 47 walk-forward windows over 24240 bars of 1H data (development set only).
